title: :lock: :robot: CI Update lock files for main CI build(s) :lock: :robot:
body:
Update lock files.

The update was generated by running:
```
python build_tools/update_environments_and_lock_files.py --select-tag main-ci
```

### Note
If the CI tasks fail, create a new branch based on this PR and add the required fixes to that branch.
Prefer re-running the same command above (with the matching `--select-tag`) rather than updating all lock files.
Remember to include `[doc build]` in your commit message so that the optional CI build runs.
